summary: Safe Area Context 5 requires React Native 0.74 or newer, and the mobile application declares React Native 0.76.5, so the documented major-version floor is satisfied.

findings.title: Declared React Native version clears the v5 floor
findings.impact: The v5 release raises the minimum React Native version to 0.74 without other documented breaking changes; this application declares 0.76.5 alongside the upgraded package.
recommendedChecks: Install the mobile workspace and smoke-test safe-area layout on its supported iOS and Android runtimes; no React Native upgrade is required by the documented floor.

omittedConcerns: Web edges behavior and tvOS/macOS fixes are omitted because the supplied repository evidence does not show those targets or SafeAreaView usage.
